newsitem.title: USA: ContiFinancial takes 30 pct stake in CMG.
newsitem.headline: ContiFinancial takes 30 pct stake in CMG.

text.p: ContiFinancial Corp said it executed a definitive agreement to acquire up to a 30 percent equity interest in CMG Funding Corp, formerly known as Continental Mortgage Group LLC.
The company said this strategic alliance was expected to close by the first quarter of 1997.

Under the terms of the deal, ContiFinancial would receive a 30 percent ownership stake in CMG and would provide warehouse funding and other financing to let CMG accumulate and securitize certain non-conforming home equity loans.
ContiFinancial said it would also provide securitization and bond placement services to CMG through a subsidiary.
James Moore, president and chief executive officer of ContiFinancial, said the alliance was key to ContiFinancial's plan to increase its presence in the western United States.
ContiFinancial is a consumer and commercial finance company based in New York.
CMG, headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, originates home equity and conforming mortgage loans currently totalling about $30 million per month.
